captions.detailed: A black workshop box fan featuring a square main body housing, a front safety grille, and a multi-blade fan inside. It is supported by a low-profile floor cradle stand. The main fan housing can tilt vertically on its horizontal pivot joints, while the internal fan blades, the side tilt-lock knob, and the front speed control knob are all designed to rotate continuously.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a workshop box fan with a square housing, front safety grille, internal rotating blades, and a floor cradle stand. Include continuous rotational joints for the fan blades, the side tilt-lock knob, and the front speed knob, allowing the main housing to tilt on horizontal pivots.
captions.factory: Create the floor cradle using extruded rectangular profiles and side pivot supports. Model the main housing as a hollowed-out box with a grid-pattern front grille. Construct the fan blades using angled extrusions arrayed around a central cylinder hub. Add the side tilt-lock knob and front speed knob as cylindrical parts, and define continuous joint articulations for the blades, knobs, and the housing's tilt axis.
